properties.name: Canada, as simple boxes
properties.note: Boxes, not borders, like street-map-us-region.geojson: a strip of the northern United States and open ocean are included, so a border town draws whole from either file. Greenland is left out (only a sliver of its west coast falls inside the northern box). Drawn 2026-11-22 for `pmtiles extract --region`; one region archive of North America (OSE-2210).
